headline.text: Executive Summary: Rybrevant momentum builds on efficacy messaging but safety concerns emerging

footer.text: Source: Rybrevant PET Q1 2026, n=312 NSCLC prescribers.

components.text: 1. Efficacy message recall dipped 3pp QoQ (42% vs 45%), driven by reduced rep reach in academic centers. Safety message recall ticked up 2pp — see Slide 5.
2. Prescription intent for Rybrevant+Lazcluze in 1L EGFRm NSCLC rose to 68% (T2B), up 4pp QoQ — the strongest single-wave gain in 6 waves. Tagrisso intent flat at 72% — see Slides 8-9.
3. Rep quality scores remain strong (82% T2B) but frequency of visits declined in community settings, mirroring access restrictions flagged in Q4 — see Slide 12.
4. Patient allocation shifted +5pp toward Rybrevant (30% vs 25%) at Tagrisso's expense (-3pp). Other EGFRi therapies stable — see Slide 14.
5. High-impact interactions drove disproportionate recall lift: HCPs with ≥2 high-impact touches showed 15pp higher efficacy recall vs low-touch cohort — see Slide 16.

metadata.speaker_notes: ES covers 5 key findings across message recall, Rx intent, rep performance, patient allocation, and HII impact. Citations: slides 5, 8-9, 12, 14, 16.
